## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the new behaviour; a bug fix has a regression test
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased
- [ ] Documentation in `docs/` updated if the API, the environment variables, the recipe or an output file changed
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` and `ruff` pass; the tests pass
- [ ] Ported ANTs/ITK code carries its Apache header and a row in `docs/THIRD_PARTY_PORTS.md`
- [ ] New files carry an SPDX header or are covered by `REUSE.toml`
